system.description:
Requires: a source of water in Reach. 1+ Actions, Reach: 2. Describe your Small or Tiny water/ice effect to the GM, or choose one from the list below. The longer or more powerful the effect, the more Actions it costs. Effects must be utilitarian and cannot replace attacks or tiered abilities.

  • Control liquid (not inside a creature), changing its temperature, reshaping it, etc.
  • Pull water from a plant.
  • Create a cloud.
  • Remove water from mud to create dirt.
  • Wash dirt & stains from an object.
